palette: deep copper sepia, burnished copper, parchment cream, patina green, key gold, brick red, umber ink
typography: delivery-hall headings on copper rail tabs, parchment chips and brick wax verdicts
composition: a registry counter with a certificate-versus-ledger pair, a dual requirement split for actual delivery, and three constructive delivery lanes closing on a date strip
surface: parchment files, copper desk rails, patina tags, key brass tokens, brick wax seals
motion: a false-material chip travels into the applicant liability slot and morphs into damages while an error chip reaches the agency and a recovery arrow carries the claim back; a goods token passes the intent gate then the possession gate to reach the change terminal with failing tokens bouncing off each gate; three constructive lanes move ownership chips while goods stay put, a pledge chip is blocked by the assignment barrier and completes only on the real-delivery date
transition: the copper hall floor, copper rails and key token posts persist while counter, gate and lanes are re-dressed between scenes
